attorneys: John R. Mahoney, Elmer C. Maddy, Alan B. Aldwell, Walter Carroll and Allen E. Charles for movants. John J. O’Connor and John J. O’Connor, Jr. filed a reply for the Isbrandtsen Company, Inc., respondent, in opposition to- the motion.
